name: code_run_tests
description: Run Ledgerline's test suite, fixtures/repo/test/, on one branch of the remote, and report the result. It changes nothing. The result is JSON {ref, passed, tests, failed}: passed is true when no test failed, and failed lists the failing tests' names; an empty failed list means every test passed. At most 50 names are listed.

ref.description: The branch to test: main, develop, or a pull request's branch such as repomind/issue-4192.

examples.note: the typical call: the branch of the pull request this run opened
a hard case: the base, to tell a failure the change brought from one already there
